text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain to send aid to Iran to help earthquake victims.
- Three petrochemical projects worth millions of dinars are expected to be set up in Bahrain.
- Government price controls on cars, fruits and vegetables may be lifted soon, but subsidies on meat, wheat flour, chicken and feedstock will remain in place.
- Bahraini and Algerian officials study ways of training Algerians in the Bahraini bourse. Algeria's commerce minister is currently visiting Bahrain to open an Algerian exhibition.
